reason: Alert 1 (java/xss) is False Positive. The sink expression at lines 92-99 concatenates 'user', 'rememberMe.getName()', and 'rememberMe.getValue()'. Tracing the data flow: 'user' is constructed from the literal 'SafeLogan' and the runtime class name ('testCaseNumber'), neither of which accept user input. 'rememberMe.getName()' returns the cookie name, also derived from the class name. 'rememberMe.getValue()' returns a randomly generated key ('rememberMeKey') from SecureRandom. Although user input is captured into 'param' at line 42, it is passed to 'thing.doSomething(param)' and never concatenated into the response writer's println statement. The resolved sink value contains no attacker-controlled data.
